description: A list of actions in a bottom alert sheet, with a separate Cancel button, opened from a trigger.
overview:
`ActionMenu` is a thin layer over `AlertSheet`. `ActionMenuContent` groups its items into one rounded block and appends a separate Cancel button below it.

Use it when a button should offer a short list of choices, such as share, duplicate or delete, without leaving the screen.
usage:
Wrap a pressable in `ActionMenuTrigger` and list `ActionMenuItem`s inside `ActionMenuContent`. Add an `ActionMenuLabel` first to show a title.

The menu can be uncontrolled or controlled with `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`. Set `variant="destructive"` on an item for actions that delete or remove.

examples.OpenByDefault: Shows the sheet on first render with `defaultOpen`.

parts.ActionMenu: The root that owns the open state.
parts.ActionMenuTrigger: The element that opens the sheet.
parts.ActionMenuContent: The sheet with the grouped items and a Cancel button.
parts.ActionMenuLabel: A title shown at the top of the group.
parts.ActionMenuItem: An actionable entry, rendered as an `AlertSheetAction`.
parts.ActionMenuSeparator: Kept for API parity; renders nothing.

ActionMenu.open: Controls whether the sheet is open.
ActionMenu.defaultOpen: Whether the sheet starts open when uncontrolled.
ActionMenu.onOpenChange: Called when the sheet opens or closes.
ActionMenu.dismissible: When `false`, the sheet ignores outside presses and closes only through an item or Cancel. Defaults to `true`.

ActionMenuContent.cancelLabel: Text of the Cancel button. Defaults to `Cancel`.

accessibility:
- When `dismissible` is `false`, the sheet uses the alert dialog primitive instead of the dialog primitive.
- Disabled items are styled with `text-label-quaternary`.
notes:
- Item text uses `text-link`, or `text-danger` for the `destructive` variant.
- On iOS the sheet renders in a full-window overlay so it appears above native screens.
